Product Manager
Acme Corp

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the roadmap for our core B2B SaaS platform.

Responsibilities

  • Define and prioritize the product roadmap in collaboration with engineering and design.
  • Work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and customer success to gather requirements.
  • Write clear product specs and acceptance criteria for engineering teams.
  • Analyze product metrics and drive data-informed decisions.
  • Communicate roadmap status and trade-offs to executive stakeholders.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS.
  • Track record of shipping successful features in an agile environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working with APIs and technical integrations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with enterprise software.
  • Familiarity with SQL or data analysis tools.

Benefits

  • Fully remote role, US-based candidates only.
  • Competitive salary and equity package.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
